inputs.name: GitSourceAdapter.constructor.root
inputs.description: Path passed to Git operations as the repository working directory. It determines which repository this adapter instance reads.

inputs.name: GitSourceAdapter.revision.query
inputs.description: Selects a local branch and optionally a commit for revision resolution. A null branch uses the current local branch, while a supplied commit must be an ancestor of the selected branch tip.

inputs.name: GitSourceAdapter.commits.branch
inputs.description: Name of the local branch whose tip is used to read commit history. The history result is limited to the 200 commits requested by the Git log command.

inputs.name: GitSourceAdapter.units.revision
inputs.description: Git revision resolved to a commit before unit manifest files are read. The resulting manifest promise is cached by resolved commit for this adapter instance.

inputs.name: GitSourceAdapter.changed.revision
inputs.description: Git revision passed to diff-tree to list paths changed in that commit, including a root commit. The returned paths are collected in a Set.

inputs.name: GitSourceAdapter.sources.unit
inputs.description: Manifest whose owns.source entries select the repository files included in the result. Each entry matches itself and descendants below that entry after a trailing slash is removed.

inputs.name: GitSourceAdapter.sources.revision
inputs.description: Git revision used to list repository paths before applying the unit source rules. The paths are returned as repository-relative names.

inputs.name: GitSourceAdapter.source.unit
inputs.description: Manifest whose owns.source entries define which repository paths may be read. A path outside those entries is rejected.

inputs.name: GitSourceAdapter.source.revision
inputs.description: Git revision passed to the source text reader after the requested path is checked against the unit source list. The returned text is read from that revision.

inputs.name: GitSourceAdapter.source.path
inputs.description: Repository-relative file path requested from the selected revision. It must be listed by sources for the unit or the method throws.

inputs.name: GitSourceAdapter.documentation.unit
inputs.description: Manifest that supplies the documentation reference for the reader. If the value is undefined or has no documentation field, the method returns undefined without resolving the revision.

inputs.name: GitSourceAdapter.documentation.revision
inputs.description: Git revision resolved to a commit before the declared documentation is read. It is not resolved when the manifest has no documentation field.

inputs.name: GitSourceAdapter.size.unit
inputs.description: Manifest whose owned source files determine which Git blobs are measured. An empty matching file list produces available false and the text Not measured.

inputs.name: GitSourceAdapter.size.revision
inputs.description: Git revision used for source enumeration and for each git cat-file size lookup. This method passes the revision through without first resolving it with gitRevision.

inputs.name: GitSourceAdapter.contractHash.unit
inputs.description: Manifest whose contract value is serialized with JSON.stringify and hashed with SHA-256. Other manifest fields are not included in the digest.

outputs.name: GitSourceAdapter.branches
outputs.description: Returns local branch refs as name, tip and current entries. The current flag is true only for the name matching symbolic HEAD; when HEAD is detached, no branch is marked current.

outputs.name: GitSourceAdapter.revision
outputs.description: Returns the selected branch name, resolved commit, branch tip and whether the commit equals the tip. A supplied commit must resolve within the selected branch ancestry.

outputs.name: GitSourceAdapter.commits
outputs.description: Returns up to 200 commits reachable from the selected branch tip. Each entry contains the commit hash, author and committer timestamps from Git, and subject.

outputs.name: GitSourceAdapter.units
outputs.description: Returns manifests parsed from specification/units/*.json at the resolved commit after checking each manifest ID against its filename. The resolved commit is used as the per-instance cache key.

outputs.name: GitSourceAdapter.changed
outputs.description: Returns a Set of repository-relative paths reported by diff-tree for the requested revision. NUL-separated empty entries are removed and duplicate paths collapse in the Set.

outputs.name: GitSourceAdapter.sources
outputs.description: Returns repository-relative paths that match an owns.source entry or lie below one after its trailing slash is removed. Paths are selected from the Git tree at the requested revision.

outputs.name: GitSourceAdapter.source
outputs.description: Returns the requested repository-relative path and its text read from the selected revision. The path is returned only after it passes the unit source check.

outputs.name: GitSourceAdapter.documentation
outputs.description: Returns undefined when the unit has no documentation field; otherwise returns the result of readUnitDocumentation using Git text from the resolved commit. The documentation result shape is determined by that reader.

outputs.name: GitSourceAdapter.size
outputs.description: Returns available and text fields for the total size of files selected by the unit source rules. The size is the summed Git blob byte count divided by 1024 and formatted to one decimal place, or Not measured when no paths match.

outputs.name: GitSourceAdapter.contractHash
outputs.description: Returns the lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 digest of JSON.stringify(unit.contract). The digest does not cover the rest of the manifest.

errors.name: Invalid Git revision or source scope
errors.description: Revision selection throws when no local branch is available or the commit fails the branch ancestry check, and source reading throws when a path is outside the unit source contract. Errors rejected by awaited Git, blob, manifest and documentation readers also propagate.

outputs.name: GitSourceAdapter.branches
outputs.description: Returns local branch refs as name, tip and current entries. The current flag is true only for the name matching symbolic HEAD; when HEAD is detached, no branch is marked current.

errors.name: Local Git branch enumeration failure
errors.description: Rejects if listing local branch refs fails; failure to resolve symbolic HEAD is caught and leaves no branch marked current.

inputs.name: GitSourceAdapter.revision.query
inputs.description: Selects a local branch and optionally a commit for revision resolution. A null branch uses the current local branch, while a supplied commit must be an ancestor of the selected branch tip.

outputs.name: GitSourceAdapter.revision
outputs.description: Returns the selected branch name, resolved commit, branch tip and whether the commit equals the tip. A supplied commit must resolve within the selected branch ancestry.

errors.name: No local branch or commit outside the branch
errors.description: Throws when no local named branch is selected or when the selected commit fails the branch ancestry check. Git revision-resolution failures also reject.

inputs.name: GitSourceAdapter.commits.branch
inputs.description: Name of the local branch whose tip is used to read commit history. The history result is limited to the 200 commits requested by the Git log command.

outputs.name: GitSourceAdapter.commits
outputs.description: Returns up to 200 commits reachable from the selected branch tip. Each entry contains the commit hash, author and committer timestamps from Git, and subject.

errors.name: Git history or branch selection failure
errors.description: Rejects if branch selection fails or the Git log read fails.

inputs.name: GitSourceAdapter.units.revision
inputs.description: Git revision resolved to a commit before unit manifest files are read. The resulting manifest promise is cached by resolved commit for this adapter instance.

outputs.name: GitSourceAdapter.units
outputs.description: Returns manifests parsed from specification/units/*.json at the resolved commit after checking each manifest ID against its filename. The resolved commit is used as the per-instance cache key.

errors.name: Revision manifest read or validation failure
errors.description: Rejects on revision, tree or blob read failures, JSON or manifest-schema parse failures, or a manifest ID that does not match its filename.

inputs.name: GitSourceAdapter.changed.revision
inputs.description: Git revision passed to diff-tree to list paths changed in that commit, including a root commit. The returned paths are collected in a Set.

outputs.name: GitSourceAdapter.changed
outputs.description: Returns a Set of repository-relative paths reported by diff-tree for the requested revision. NUL-separated empty entries are removed and duplicate paths collapse in the Set.

errors.name: Git tree diff failure
errors.description: Rejects when diff-tree cannot read the requested revision.

inputs.name: GitSourceAdapter.sources.revision

outputs.name: GitSourceAdapter.sources
outputs.description: Returns repository-relative paths that match an owns.source entry or lie below one after its trailing slash is removed. Paths are selected from the Git tree at the requested revision.

errors.name: Git revision file listing failure
errors.description: Rejects when the Git file listing for the revision fails.

inputs.name: GitSourceAdapter.source.revision

errors.name: Source outside the unit contract or unreadable
errors.description: Throws when the path is outside the unit source contract; Git text-read failures also reject.

inputs.description: Manifest that supplies the documentation reference for the reader. If the value is undefined or has no documentation field, the method returns undefined without resolving the revision.

inputs.name: GitSourceAdapter.documentation.revision
inputs.description: Git revision resolved to a commit before the declared documentation is read. It is not resolved when the manifest has no documentation field.

outputs.name: GitSourceAdapter.documentation
outputs.description: Returns undefined when the unit has no documentation field; otherwise returns the result of readUnitDocumentation using Git text from the resolved commit. The documentation result shape is determined by that reader.

errors.name: Revision documentation read failure
errors.description: When documentation is declared, rejects if revision resolution, Git text reading or the documentation reader fails.

inputs.name: GitSourceAdapter.size.revision
inputs.description: Git revision used for source enumeration and for each git cat-file size lookup. This method passes the revision through without first resolving it with gitRevision.

outputs.name: GitSourceAdapter.size
outputs.description: Returns available and text fields for the total size of files selected by the unit source rules. The size is the summed Git blob byte count divided by 1024 and formatted to one decimal place, or Not measured when no paths match.

inputs.description: Manifest whose contract value is serialized with JSON.stringify and hashed with SHA-256. Other manifest fields are not included in the digest.
